APPROVE

Extracting the type-dispatch into `CompareSegment` preserves behaviour (the mixed-type case returns a nonzero -1 or 1, so `c != 0` returns it immediately, exactly as the old inline `return` did), and it removes the nested `if`/`else` chain from `Compare`, which takes the method below 15. I haven't built the project, so I haven't ruled out a name clash with an existing `CompareSegment` elsewhere in the partial class.
